target_customer: Venture investors, then sales and business development teams
problem: Investors and salespeople lack structured data on startups.

founders.name: Andy Sparks
founders.background_notes: Left a year before the sale

exit.reason: Struggled to get customers to pay for data and competed with Crunchbase, PitchBook, CB Insights (per TechCrunch)

technical_complexity.rationale: Data scraping and entity matching at scale across web sources.

defensibility.rationale: Data aggregation was reproducible by larger vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors out-sold it; sold to FullContact for under 500K cash plus stock in Dec 2017.

market_need_then: Rising startup investing created demand for startup data.

branding.community_and_virality: Founder Danielle Morrill was a visible public voice; blog and newsletter

brand_strength.rationale: Strong founder led content presence; name origin not found.

pivots.why: Per founder statements in blog titles

outcome_analysis: Mattermark raised more than 17 million dollars from top investors but struggled to convince customers to pay for startup data against Crunchbase, PitchBook and CB Insights, and sold to FullContact in December 2017 for under 1 million dollars in cash and stock with common holders receiving nothing. The brand was relaunched independently in 2019.
notes: Series A amount and date from Mattermark blog URL and Seedtable; CB Insights lists 2014-12. Series B 42M valuation reported but pre or post not stated, so post_money left null. Competitors dated around 2012 not found. Name origin unknown. Pivot detail loosely sourced. Mattermark relaunched independently Feb 2019.
